title: Okada vs. Omega: breaking the Rainmaker’s reign
summary: Kenny Omega pursues the seemingly unbeatable Kazuchika Okada through defeat and a time-limit draw. Their rivalry eventually demands a match with no time limit and two falls required to win.

chapters.title: Okada wins the Dome encounter
chapters.result: Okada defeats Omega to retain the IWGP heavyweight title.
chapters.context: Omega’s first G1-winning challenge falls short, but establishes him as a sustained threat to the champion.

chapters.title: Sixty minutes cannot separate them
chapters.result: Okada and Omega wrestle to a time-limit draw.
chapters.context: Omega lasts the full hour without being beaten but still cannot take the championship, leaving the central question unresolved.

chapters.title: Omega ends the 720-day reign
chapters.result: Omega defeats Okada two falls to one with no time limit.
chapters.context: With Ibushi in his corner, Omega survives the first-fall loss and wins the next two, finally securing the heavyweight championship.
